scope: Procedural AABB RayQuery plus experimental float32 RTZ TRI0 helper for a small GPU-visible scene. This is not full shader 219 execution and is not runtime attached.
geometry: Two synthetic TRI0 records and conservative synthetic AABBs. Node words copied from upload to GPU default memory on the recorded command list before dispatch; Query candidate primitive index selects the record.
instances: ID7 identity; ID8 nonuniform X scale 2 and translation X=4; ID9 translation X=12 with mask zero.
result_format: candidate count, committed status, committed distance bits, instance ID << 16 | primitive index
observations: Interior zero hits, both node IDs, transformed instances, an included edge, an excluded edge, off-triangle and off-AABB misses, t=1 hit, and masked instance are checked.
The included edge commits negative zero; the control accepts either sign and records actual bits.

The TRI0 float32 helper matches prior native controls for sampled inputs only; numerical fidelity for exceptional ranges, all geometry flags, paired triangle variants and all cases is not established.
limitations: No queue-ordered guest geometry provenance, resource lifetime, device table publication, dynamic builds/copies/compaction or runtime consumer.
Only this fixed synthetic geometry and manually chosen conservative boxes. Bounds generation, arbitrary transforms and general zero-distance edge behavior are not proven.
RayQuery candidate ordering, exception/NaN behavior, nonopaque/opaque/culling semantics, node types 1-3, complex BLAS geometry and full 219 control flow remain unverified.
